- Task manager: stronger column separator lines between the cells.
- Keyboard: holding the copied item in the bar's right slot opens a preview (full text, large picture, a video with a small playing animation).
- YTX Downloads: Series and movies posters load with the app's own poster loader; Search is inline on the same page.
- Series covers: the picture loader uses the catalogue's trusted-server list and still loads public covers when a network breaks the certificate.
- Extra apps list: Code (the code editor) is listed.
- Keyboard bar: always three equal boxes (a long address no longer pushes the third one away).
- Series and movies streaming: tries the best shared torrents first whatever their size (up to 6), and drops one that finds no peers in 45 s or has not started after 30 s at under 30 KB/s, so the next is tried.
- Keyboard menu: Calculator, Convert, Stickers and Grammar tiles are gone from the menu (still available in the settings), Notes tile added.
- Keyboard bar: an amount with a currency ("35$", "20 eur", "£8") offers its value in lira in the middle of the bar ("500 tl" offers dollars); rates are the calculator's, refreshed every few hours.
- Windows 11 power menu: Sleep, Restart and Sign out have their own icons.
- Windows 11 turned phone: a smaller Start menu and phone panel; no second (desktop) clock beside the taskbar clock.
- Windows 11 Start: category folders (Games, Media, Communication ...) under the apps; a tap opens the folder. The live tiles are taller on a turned phone so their text is no longer cut off.
- Windows 11 search: a gap is left above the panel.
- HD wallpaper download: the button no longer depends on the saved list from GitHub (the three HD packs are known to the app), so it shows offline or with an old saved list too.
- Windows 11 Settings: a setting that led to the phone's own page now has a page of its own first (Wi-Fi, Mobile network, Bluetooth, Battery, Storage, Display with a brightness slider, Sound with volume sliders, Airplane, VPN, Focus ...) with a button for the phone's page; the window and its cards are more see-through.
- Windows 11 Settings > Personalization: Background, Colors, Themes, Start and Taskbar open the matching page of the launcher settings straight away (Look, Look and feel, App drawer, Dock), and Back leaves it instead of showing the old list.
- HD wallpapers download by themselves (no question) when a Windows 11 / 10 / 7 look is used or its wallpaper page is open.
- Files: after a file is moved to the Secure Folder its old row is removed from the gallery and media lists and the page refreshes; the move has its own icon (padlock with an arrow) in the file menu's icon row.
- Video: a refresh button; rows of files that no longer exist are not listed (and the media index is told to drop them); folder names get the smart names too, and a release site tag ("[ OxTorrent.com ]") is left out of names.
- Video: the ⋮ menus (a video's and the selection's) have an icon on every item.
- Windows 11: the launcher's list of categories is gone: Home screen, Folders, Gadgets, Desktop icons, Look and feel, Gestures, Notification badges, Clock and screen, Backup and Default home app are settings of Personalization in the Windows 11 Settings.
- Files: a message of an operation goes away by itself after five seconds; plain text files of any name (.md, .log, .conf ...) open in the code editor at once; the "Open as" list has icons and a Code editor entry.
- YTX Downloads: the names of series and film downloads are cleaned of release tags (1080p, BluRay, x265, group).
- Launcher: Look > Custom wallpaper (a picture of your own for every look, also the ones with no stock wallpaper); Personalize in the home menu opens Look directly.
- Launcher home widgets: a widget held for a moment gets controls (take it off, move left or right, done), so a placed widget can be changed or removed.
- Launcher: the desktop clock gadget is off by default (switch it on in Look); no gadget comes by itself on any look.
- Launcher app menu: the actions are icons, five to a row (a long press names the icon), instead of a long list; the tile sizes of Windows Phone stay as rows.
- Files: the Office Assistant (Clippy) is in Files too under the Windows 95 and XP looks.
- Windows 10 taskbar: the search button opens the search flyout, the connection / sound / battery button the quick settings and the clock the calendar, as in Windows 11.
- Windows 10 Settings: one flat palette for the whole window (dark: near black with grey tiles; light: pale grey with white tiles) instead of white page behind dark tiles.
- Windows 11: the start button is the blue Windows 11 mark (Look > Start button in the accent colour for the accent version); the phone panel's Messages opens Pulse's own Messages as a window.
- Windows 11 clock flyout: Focus has a real play icon (no emoji) and starts Pulse's own focus timer (the minutes set, shown counting down, stop with a tap); quick settings tiles held open their own page of Pulse's Settings in the launcher.
- Windows 11 Settings: the search box had two magnifiers; one is left.
- Spotify: a build can carry Pulse's own Spotify app (repository variable SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID, or -PspotifyClientId): the sign-in is then one press, no Client ID to type.
- Windows 11 Settings: the cards of each category are more see-through.
- Windows 11 Settings: rows that are switches in Windows (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Airplane mode) show On / Off and a switch; a tap on the switch opens the system's own panel for it (apps may not switch them).
- Windows 11 quick settings: a Screen recorder tile that opens Pulse's recorder in the launcher.
- Windows 11 Settings: Network & internet starts with a status card (connected or not); Bluetooth & devices starts with cards of the paired devices and an Add device card.
- Windows 11: a Run box (Win+R: cmd, terminal, regedit, taskmgr, control, settings, notepad, calc, explorer, paint) opened with the Run icon in the Start menu's foot.
- Windows 11 quick settings: Pulse's own tiles Motion cues (for car sickness), Floating timer and Auto clicker work from the launcher's panel at once.
- LocalSend: off until its page is opened (the always-visible setting is off by default; it stays a switch on the page).
- Downloads: the folder icon of a download opens that download's folder in the file app (held, it changes the download folder). Video: videos under 3 seconds are not listed by default (Settings > Shortest video), and so a folder with only such clips is not either.
- Extra apps page: YTXTube and Health have their Fluent colour pictures. Keyboard: the copied text in the bar leaves after one paste (it stayed for a second paste).
- Terminal: the output can be selected and copied (hold a word), copy and paste buttons, text size A- / A+, and the window is see-through under Windows 11.
- Terminal: it lifts itself above the keyboard (the empty band under the input line is gone).
- Terminal: the shell keeps running in the background like Termux: a notification (Terminal session open, with Stop) and a partial wake lock while a session is open.
- Video: Back and the mini-window item now use Android's own picture-in-picture first (the custom floating window is only the fallback)
- Video: subtitles in the system picture-in-picture window scale with the window height, so they stay readable
